capabilities: Create a command for each file chosen in settings
Open specific files via user-assigned hotkeys
Open a file in the Hover Editor popup when enabled
extras: The README mentions Ko-fi donations for supporting development.
problem: Obsidian lets you bind hotkeys to commands, but there are no built-in per-file open commands to bind.

relations.evidence: This plugin supports the Hover Editor plugin. If you have the Hover Editor plugin installed, you can open the file in the Hover Editor

summary: Plugin that creates one command per chosen file so any note can be opened with a custom hotkey.
